name: Hotel Ivy, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Minneapolis
positioning: Downtown Minneapolis hotel set in the historic Art Deco Ivy Tower, connected to the city's Skyway system, with Anda Spa on site
best_for: Travelers who want a historic Art Deco setting in downtown Minneapolis
Guests attending events at the Minnesota Convention Center, reached by climate-controlled skyways
Spa-goers drawn to crystal-based wellness at Anda Spa

facts.text: Hotel Ivy is set within a historic Art Deco tower.
The Ivy Tower's structure was first commissioned by the Second Church of Christ Scientist.
Hotel Ivy is directly connected to the Minneapolis Skyway system.
The Minnesota Convention Center is connected to Hotel Ivy by climate-controlled skyways.
Rooms and suites feature original artwork, fine linens and limestone bathrooms.
All guest rooms have a soaking tub with a separate glass-enclosed shower.
Rooms have Frette linens, a down comforter and a pillow-top mattress.
The lobby is a study in sharp edges, marble, glass and winter-white fabrics.
The fitness center at Anda Spa features Technogym equipment.
Hotel Ivy partners with the Hennepin Theatre Trust to provide access to the Hennepin Avenue cultural district.
Breva is a neighborhood bar and grill serving New American fare and craft cocktails.
Masa & Agave is an intimate speakeasy-style cantina serving a regionally inspired Mexican menu and agave spirits.

highlights.text: The Ivy Tower was added to the National Register of Historic Places in 1986; its Ziggurat style is a terraced pyramid of successively receding stories.
The Penthouse Suite has a private rooftop balcony and panoramic windows.
Anda Spa has a Crystal Sauna and hydrotherapy, offers massages, advanced facials and nail services, and draws on crystal-based wellness practices.
The Suite Serenity experience is an evening for two with private use of the Quartz spa, an Alchemy Aroma Journey and a full body exfoliation and massage.
High-floor rooms offer 10-foot ceilings, custom abstract art and bar carts.

considerations.text: Parking is off-site valet, and the hotel does not have electric vehicle charging stations.
Rooms do not have a fridge.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the upscale positioning.
